quests.title: Aranakin's Old Friend

dialogue.t: Ah, he's gone... But Paimon understands, he's forgotten our adventures together, after all.

dialogue.sit: We can be friends all over again.

dialogue.t: Yes, you're right... Oh, Paimon has an idea!
Aranakin taught us a song, right? Let's play it, and maybe he would recognize it!
Hee-hee, because Paimon is Paimon!
Haha, here he comes! Hello, little thing!
Aranakin is not a little thing! You are! You floaty white little thing!
Speaking of which, golden sand... Nara, why do you know this song?
Well...

dialogue.sit: I played this song, so that I could meet you.

dialogue.t: Yes, during our last adventure, you taught the song to us!
Is that... so? Hmph, Aranakin is not clever, but you don't look like those bad sand grains.
No, we don't! You told us that sand is Valuka. So the bad sand grains are a group of bad Nara Valuka, right? But we are good Nara!
Ohh? Did I tell you that as well?
Haha, that's right! {NICKNAME}, let's tell the stories to him again!

dialogue.sit: You recount the adventures to Aranakin, as well as how you neutralized The Withering together.

dialogue.t: ...I see.
Aranakin is not clever, but what you said, sounds to be true. Aranakin can't remember, sorry.
No, no need for that! Y'know, it's pretty normal to forget things... Besides, we can become friends again, right?
Ah... Since we're good friends, follow me then!
Oh? But...
Golden Nara and White Floaty! Come to my place, follow me!
We're here! Here it is!
This is my place, please rest here!
This is Nara instrument, Aranakin is keeping it. But it can't sing now... The strings are not in the right place.
(An antiquated oud, marked with multiple breaking scars, but seeming to be carefully-repaired and well-maintained.)
Nara... Hm, what's the name? Aranakin doesn't sleep with that, so forget the word...
It's a "bed"! It looks pretty new, indeed... Did someone sleep on it before?
Hehe, Aranakin keeps tidying it... If you want to sleep here, that's okay!
There are leaves Nara left upstairs, but... Aranakin can't read them, Aranakin doesn't understand...
Those are the leaves Nara use to keep memories... Nara write on the leaves, and put them together. But the words of Nara, Aranakin doesn't understand.
Do you mean... "notebook"?
"Notebook"...? That's how Nara keep their memories?
Yup, that's right... Will Aranakin mind if we go upstairs together, and see what it says?
Me? Not at all!
Let me know if you find anything interesting!
"...I've repaired the oud Uncle Bakr dropped, so stop crying by yourself, alright? You can talk to Khayyam and me if you're unhappy..."
"...I've been accepted into the Akademiya! Haha, congratulations to me! I don't want to be some warrior's wife! I'm going to be Siman, the Great Sage!"
"Hehe... Irfan the 'Great musician' and Khayyam 'the Wise!' Don't forget me! Especially you, Khayyam! Don't you dare forget me!"
"...Farewell, notebook! Farewell, Irfan and Siman, my best friends! I hope that the forest never forgets our story, and I hope we remember each other..."
(...The rest is a mess and filled with the children's happy and sorrowful memories...)
"...Aranakin is gone. Vanished into thin air, and without so much as a sign as to when. It's time for me to bid farewell to the oud too. I'll be a craftsman, just like my father had hoped I would..."
(There seems to be more, but it's been crossed and blacked out with ink.)
"...To the person reading this notebook, if I by some miracle am allowed to meet Aranakin and the others again, years from now, then please give this flower to him..."
Hey, something fell out of the notebook!
It looks like... a flower? It looks... exactly like the ones we got.
What memories is it keeping? What did you see?

dialogue.sit: It seems that the owner of the notebook knows you.

dialogue.t: Is that so...? I can't remember...
He said... He couldn't see you anymore. Because he grew up, maybe...
Hmm... Growing up is really troubling.
Oh right! He also said in the notebook that... This flower is for you!
Huh...? Ahh! This flower is very important! Why do you... how did he get it?
Actually, you once gave us the same flower as well... It's just that you forgot everything.
Really...? I can still make friends with you again. But... As for him, I can't even recall his face...
I—It's okay... Don't be sad, we still have this flower. It will bring you more memories, right?
Yes, White Floaty is right.
I am taking this flower back, Mawtiyima should know how to wake her up.
Hmm... Nara {NICKNAME} and White Floaty, I am going back to where Aranaga is, planting her, and listening to her songs. If you are not busy, you know where to find us!
Yes, see you soon!
Thank you, Nara {NICKNAME} and White Floaty! I'm going back to where Aranaga is. You can find me there!

quests.description: After that last adventure, Aranakin really forgot a lot of things. No matter what, how could the new and old friends he made be forgotten so easily?
